description: CR 609.4b two only-clauses about one red mana each permit their own type
note: docs/decisions.md, "How two only-clauses about spending one mana combine". Under Celestial Dawn alice may spend her red mana only as though it were colorless; under Synthetic Verdant Prism, only as though it were green. Parun takes the union, so the floating {R} pays Llanowar Elves' {G}. The rejected reading makes each "only" a prohibition of the other's type (CR 101.2), and the red mana pays neither, so the Elves cannot be cast. The mana floats rather than coming off a land, since Celestial Dawn makes every land of alice's a Plains. Synthetic because Celestial Dawn is the one printing with an only-clause: MTGJSON AtomicCards of 2026-10-08, every text with "only as though", 2026-10-19.
